overview_description.description: ILabService simplifies lab operation by using IoT and AI technologies. The company provides subscription monitoring services for lab equipment in biotechnology and pharmaceutical labs. Their software and easy-to-install sensors ensure each piece of equipment is operating according to their specifications, alerting technicians when there are problems.

about_short_description.short_description: ILabService simplifies lab operation by using IoT and AI technologies.

product.name: 监控保 (Monitoring Protection)
product.description: A cloud-based IoT and AI system for real-time monitoring of laboratory equipment and environment, providing alerts for anomalies to ensure safety and compliance.

product.name: 仪器保 (Instrument Protection)
product.description: A lifecycle management platform for laboratory instruments that tracks usage, maintenance, and sharing to optimize asset utilization and reduce costs.

product.name: 库存保 (Inventory Protection)
product.description: A laboratory inventory management system that tracks chemical and reagent stocks in real time, ensuring safety, compliance, and efficient usage.

identifier.value: 智能硬件产品 (Smart Hardware Products)

product.name: 智能硬件产品 (Smart Hardware Products)
product.description: A range of wireless IoT sensors and devices integrated with software for monitoring laboratory parameters such as temperature, humidity, gas concentration, and equipment status.

identifier.value: 数智化卫生监督 (Digital Health Supervision)

product.name: 数智化卫生监督 (Digital Health Supervision)
product.description: A digital platform for remote health and safety supervision of medical and laboratory facilities, integrating IoT monitoring and AI for compliance and risk management.
